name: Fixer Upper
description: Sees potential in broken things and people, believes everything can be repaired
behavioral_signature: Takes on partners and friends as projects to improve
under_stress: Can't accept that some things are too broken to fix
at_rest: Evaluating what needs improvement in the people around them
will_always: see what someone could be instead of what they are
will_never: accept someone exactly as they are without wanting to adjust something
unless: they learn that acceptance is sometimes more powerful than improvement
